Beauty = products with business unit “beauty”. Brand, category and sub-category come from the product catalogue (item_d); “(none)” means the field is blank there. Targets, when added, apply to all of Beauty and are hidden while a filter is active. GMV is gross (incl. VAT, all item statuses including cancelled and returned). Units = gross items. ASP = GMV ÷ units. MKD % = markdown discount ÷ normal price (AED). PC1 % = PC1 ÷ gross revenue. Prov. PC1 % = provisional PC1 ÷ gross revenue. Overall covers all countries, KSA and UAE included. Ratios are calculated from summed values. Change vs LY/LLY is % for value metrics and percentage points (pp) for % metrics. Today is excluded because the day is still in progress.
